groups.title: Identity
groups.heading: The familiar name, given room to breathe.
groups.description: English-only Kabita Live masthead; the existing symbol; Odia signature kept separate.
checks: Keep the original proportions.
Keep the menu readable.
Do not repeat the signature in the footer.

groups.title: Colour
groups.heading: Stone, sea and hearth.
groups.description: Use the approved palette by role. Language does not determine colour.
checks: Ink for reading; laterite for restrained emphasis.
Rules are decorative, not text colours.
Night colours need their own contrast check.

groups.title: Typography
groups.heading: Three scripts, equal care.
groups.description: Cormorant Garamond 500 for English display; Source Serif 4 for English reading; Noto Serif Oriya for Odia; Tiro Devanagari Hindi 400 for Hindi.
checks: Check conjuncts and vowel marks.
Use natural Indic character spacing.
Preserve poet names and original line breaks.

groups.title: Paper & atmosphere
groups.heading: A quiet surface beneath the words.
groups.description: Cotton paper for general pages; stable monsoon or earth wash for poems. No texture in night reading.
checks: Cotton at 16%; poem wash at 18%, softened on phones.
Atmosphere must never compete with the text.
Art stays still.

groups.title: Spacing & rhythm
groups.heading: How much room should a poem have?
groups.description: Choose a default rhythm for related content. Preserve optical adjustments for Odia and long titles.
checks: Compare 48px and 32px between major content groups.
Both use the same 4–64px spacing scale.
Review the phone preview before approving.

groups.title: Page openings
groups.heading: An invitation before the reading begins.
groups.description: The approved 60% text / 40% artwork split remains. Compare supporting copy and vertical rhythm.
checks: One clear page purpose and action.
Artwork changes by page family.
Both versions stack on small screens.

groups.title: Navigation
groups.heading: A clear way in, and a clear way back.
groups.description: Retain the shared masthead and single-line desktop footer. Choose the mobile menu treatment.
checks: Try Menu with keyboard and touch.
Current page has a visible label.
Footer links remain together and left-aligned on phones.

groups.title: Poem reading
groups.heading: Let the words set the pace.
groups.description: Compare a single-line reading toolbar with grouped controls. Try all three scripts, enlargement and night reading.
checks: Keep authored lines and stanza spacing.
Large text must wrap without clipping.
Night reading and text-size controls must announce their state.

groups.title: Buttons & links
groups.heading: One clear action, without shouting.
groups.description: Compare square and gently softened buttons. Both keep a filled primary action, outlined secondary action and underlined text links.
checks: Inspect default, hover, focus and disabled examples.
Primary controls have a 48px minimum target.
External links keep the quiet directional mark.

groups.title: Cards & metadata
groups.heading: A poem, a poet, a place in the journal.
groups.description: Compare open cards with a fine rule against pale-paper panels. Test long titles and native names.
checks: Keep title, poet, issue and language in a consistent order.
Use real cover art without crowding it.
Whole-card links must not swallow secondary actions.

groups.title: Forms
groups.heading: Make writing to the journal feel simple.
groups.description: Compare white-paper fields with fields that share the page surface. Try the required-field errors and preview confirmation.
checks: Visible labels remain above fields.
Errors name the problem beside the field.
No message is sent from this review sample.

groups.title: Messages & recovery
groups.heading: Kind words when something needs attention.
groups.description: Compare a quiet margin rule with a pale-paper panel for success, error, loading and empty states.
checks: Use wording as well as colour.
Give errors an actionable next step.
Loading, unavailable and empty results are different states.

groups.title: Search & filters
groups.heading: A word can lead somewhere.
groups.description: Compare underlined language choices with filled selected filters. Search the three preview poems and try a no-result query.
checks: Filters belong near results, never in the masthead.
Announce the result count.
Clear filters must restore the complete sample list.

groups.title: Sharing & dialogs
groups.heading: Let a poem travel with its poet.
groups.description: Compare a compact share dialog with one that includes an artwork preview. Both preserve title, poet and original link.
checks: Try opening, Escape, closing and focus return.
Copy only reports success after clipboard permission succeeds.
External publishing is not performed by the sample.

groups.title: Artwork & portraits
groups.heading: A cultural narrative, with room to breathe.
groups.description: Compare a soft watercolour edge with a clean rectangular crop. Examine banner, cover and portrait treatment together.
checks: Preserve faces and important focal points.
Do not invent documentary provenance.
Credits live in the colophon; meaningful titles remain.

groups.title: Rules & small marks
groups.heading: A small pause between thoughts.
groups.description: Keep the approved header separator. Compare a plain section rule with the existing flowing waterline for occasional editorial transitions.
checks: Do not place ornamental dividers above and below the same heading.
Use the end mark once per poem.
External marks remain quieter than their link text.

groups.title: Motion & focus
groups.heading: Enough movement to make an action clear.
groups.description: Compare immediate state changes with a brief 160ms colour transition. Reduced-motion preference always disables the transition.
checks: No parallax or animated backgrounds.
Keyboard focus remains visible.
Motion must not be required to understand a state.

groups.title: Credits & colophon
groups.heading: Credit once; keep authorship close.
groups.description: Design, font, artwork and portrait-source credits live on Our Story. Poet, translator and reviewer bylines stay beside the work.
checks: Keep LIFE AS IT IS as an artwork title.
Use the existing Our story footer link.
Carry provenance with independently shared exports.
